Messages.Author: Megakannon
Messages.Body: Why does this card have text stating the vampire must be ready to modify another minions action when the general rulings already prohibit such modifications from torpor?

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
When you ask question, add the card text to your post.

> Only usable by a ready untapped vampire other than the acting minion you control. After playing this card, you cannot play another action modifier to further increase the bleed for this action.
> [dom] The acting minion gets +1 bleed.
> [DOM] As above, but usable by a ready tapped vampire.
>
The text of the card replace the normal condition to play an action modifier, to allow it to be played by a minion which is not acting. It specify "ready" for two reason :
* it's clearer
* ally can be not ready but not be in torpor, for example when they are recruited. Since some ally can play action modifier as vampires, it prevent the corner case of thoses ally using a card the turn they are recruited.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
> Megakannon wrote:
> the general rulings already prohibit such modifications from torpor?
>
They don't.

According to the rules, only the acting minion can play action modifiers. It often entails that he is ready, but not always. A vampire trying to leave torpor can play stealth (or even better: Daring the Dawn  ) when someone attempts to block him.

Action modifiers played by a non-acting minion such as Empowering the Puppet King are an exception to the rules. As such, they need to have their own rules on them.

Reactions, on the other hand, are indeed reserved to ready minions in the rules.

Generic rule is that action modifiers can be played by the acting vampire, regardless if he is ready or not. Empowering changes the standard "acting, ready or not" into "not acting but ready".

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Megakannon wrote:
> Why does this card have text stating the vampire must be ready to modify another minions action when the general rulings already prohibit such modifications from torpor?
>
The Rulebook simply prohibits non-acting minions from playing action modifiers:
Rulebook 1.6.3.2  wrote:
>
> Action modifier cards: The acting minion can play these cards to modify his action.
>
This means that only the acting minion can play action modifier cards, unless cardtext says something else.
Acting vampires in torpor can play action modifiers just as much as ready minions can. Usually, that's limited to stealth (and similar) cards, as they're trying to leave torpor / gain 4-5 blood.

What the General Rulings page reads (everyone here seems to have skipped the fact that the question isn't about the rules, but about the rulings) is:
General Rulings  wrote:
>
> Action Modifiers / Reaction: Action modifiers cannot be played by a vampire in torpor unless that vampire is the acting minion.  [RTR 19970306]
>
What this means is that vampires in torpor cannot play action modifiers that read "Usable by a minion who is not the acting minion." or something similar (for instance: Cloak the Gathering, Veil the Legion, ...)

Now, most of these cards already read "only usable by a ready ...". The only one that I can think of that doesn't would be sup' Blanket of Night, which, per that ruling, cannot be played by a vampire in torpor.

This redundancy is sometimes simpler than omitting the "ready" word on the card, because it avoids questions such as "Can I play Blanket of Night with my non acting vampire in torpor? But why not? It doesn't read 'ready'!"
